# sentry_external_user (Resource)

Sentry External User. Links a Sentry user to a user in an external provider, so that CODEOWNERS handles such as `@octocat` resolve to the Sentry user, or so that Slack and Microsoft Teams identities map to the Sentry user. Sentry only allows this on organizations with the `integrations-codeowners` feature enabled; otherwise the API returns `403 Forbidden`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_organization_integration" "github" {
  organization = "my-organization"

  provider_key = "github"
  name         = "my-github-organization"
}

# Resolve the "@octocat" CODEOWNERS handle to a Sentry user
resource "sentry_external_user" "octocat" {
  organization   = "my-organization"
  user_id        = "12345" # the Sentry user ID, not the organization member ID
  provider_name  = "github"
  external_name  = "@octocat"
  integration_id = data.sentry_organization_integration.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_name` (String) The name of the user in the external provider, such as `@octocat`. GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Cursor names must start with `@`.
- `integration_id` (String) The ID of the organization integration the mapping belongs to, for example `data.sentry_organization_integration.slack.id`.
- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization the user belongs to.
- `provider_name` (String) The external provider. Named `provider_name` because `provider` is a reserved Terraform meta-argument. One of: `github`, `github_enterprise`, `jira_server`, `slack`, `slack_staging`, `perforce`, `gitlab`, `cursor_origin`, `msteams`, `custom_scm`.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the Sentry user to link. This is the user ID, not the organization member ID. The user must be a member of the organization.

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) The ID of the user in the external provider, such as a Slack member ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sentry_external_user.default org-slug/external-user-id
```
